data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

**Q1 2026 OKRs (January 1 - March 31)**

**Objective 1: Accelerate Product Innovation & Market Fit**
*   KR1.1: Launch 2 new AI features (Project Gemini & Project Atlas) by end of Q1.
*   KR1.2: Achieve a user adoption rate of 15% for new features within 30 days post-launch.
*   KR1.3: Conduct 10 enterprise beta tests and incorporate 50+ pieces of direct user feedback into the product backlog.

**Objective 2: Drive Revenue Growth & Expand Market Share**
*   KR2.1: Increase total recurring revenue by 25% quarter-over-quarter.
*   KR2.2: Expand into 2 new geographic markets (EMEA & APAC) with localized sales teams.
*   KR2.3: Secure 5 new enterprise-level contracts (ARR > $500k).

**Objective 3: Enhance Operational Excellence & Team Scalability**
*   KR3.1: Improve system reliability to 99.9% uptime (SLO) across all services.
*   KR3.2: Hire and onboard 15 new engineers across key verticals (Backend, Infra, ML).
*   KR3.3: Implement 3 new cross-team efficiency workflows, aiming for a 10% reduction in time-to-resolution for Tier 2+ customer issues.

**Key Points / Executive Summary:**
*   **Focus:** Growth, innovation, and operational foundation. Q1 is about building momentum.
*   **Metrics:** Heavy emphasis on revenue (KR2.1), launch cadence (KR1.1), and system reliability (KR3.1) as the bedrock for scaling.
*   **Risks:** Resource constraints in EMEA/APAC expansion (KR2.2) and enterprise sales cycle timing (KR2.3).
*   **Owners:** Product (Obj1), Sales & Marketing (Obj2), Engineering & Ops (Obj3).

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.
